_doc: JLC placement-angle offsets, per LCSC part and side: CPL rotation = (KiCad rotation + offset) mod 360. Only parts a person saw right in JLC placement preview (2026-11-07, r7b M2) are here; every other polarized part is UNKNOWN (not 0) and must be checked in the preview. pin1_local is pin 1 in the footprint frame (rotation and bottom mirror undone) of the verified part: a footprint whose pin 1 moves no longer matches. tools/fab_pack.py writes the CPL from this file, tools/cpl_pin1.py checks the CPL against it.

U15.why: same LCSC part as U2 (verified on the bottom) but on the top side; JLC top/bottom angle conventions differ per part, so NOT verified. r7 wrote CPL 0 for it.
